approach: At most N - 2 jumps allows visiting at most (N - 2) + 1 = N - 1 contiguous lily pads in the line.
observation: Finding the maximum sum of N - 1 contiguous lily pads is equivalent to finding the sliding window of size N - 1 with the maximum sum.
bruteForce: Try all possible starting positions and paths of length N - 1.
optimalSolution: Calculate total sum of all N pads and subtract the minimum of A[0] and A[N-1], or compute the sum of the first N - 1 pads and last N - 1 pads and return the maximum.
edgeCases: Large 64-bit integer petal counts up to 10^9
